name: Executor: Main Corridor
status: Implemented native card text; primary rules and pinned source review; no executed GEMP oracle for this card. Production admission remains closed.
semantics: Free regular movement during Dark own move phase from Main Corridor to Executor or any other named Executor site, and vice versa. Site-site movement does not require Executor on table or adjacency.
Light control cancels the Dark-side permission while control persists. Whole-site text suppression also removes the Dark permission.
Executor_site uses siteOfStarshipOrVehicle(EXECUTOR,true) in pinned Filters, so nonunique Star Destroyer: Launch Bay is not an Executor site for the named text even while associated with Executor.

Ordinary move restrictions, one regular move, own hull capacity, pilots/drivers and current destination restrictions still apply. Lift Tube may travel between the interior mobile sites, never aboard the hull.

Continuation binds physical moving card, source/destination, originating location, and exact Main Corridor source. Returned source/hull/mover cannot inherit the initiated transfer. Movement is revalidated after responses.
limitations: This receipt does not assert executed GEMP parity.
Future card interactions, other Executor site texts, and underlying full-catalog movement restrictions remain subject to their own admission coverage.
Laser Gate endpoint and rearrangement geometry remains separately unresolved; no guessed layout behavior was added.
